analysis: The trial crashed after consuming 865.26 GPU-seconds and produced no accepted validation score. The supplied traceback only reports train.py exiting with status 1; it does not expose the underlying exception, so the failure cannot be attributed to training, verification, memory usage, or predictor loading. No improvement or regression relative to the referenced 0.5175 and 0.5388 scores is established.
code_summary: One independently trained RecurrentMemory model per category uses 96-dimensional embeddings, a normalized GRU backbone, length-64 histories, and dropout 0.25. Candidate embeddings query causally masked contextual history states; retrieved context, the current recurrent state, and candidate embedding enter a shared MLP with learned item bias. Training and prediction share the scorer, with chunked attention and activation checkpointing during training. Training retains 32 negatives, temporally weighted sampled-softmax plus 0.2-weighted BCE, AdamW, cosine decay, and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor writer exports the complete architecture and strictly loads one checkpoint per dataset route. Post-training assertions cover finite padded-history scores, causality, candidate-order/chunk invariance, forward/predict agreement, and reload parity; their completion is unconfirmed.
